agents.interrupt_message.name: Record native interruption messages
agents.interrupt_message.description: Record a model-visible message when an agent turn is interrupted. Unset inherits Codex configuration; the Codex default is true.

gpt-6.1-sol.description: 编码与日常工作的主力模型

priority.name: Fast
priority.description: 优先服务档，具体用量以 Codex 为准

flex.name: Flex
flex.description: 灵活服务档，具体可用性以目录为准

model_reasoning_summary.name: 推理摘要
model_reasoning_summary.description: 控制 Codex 提供的推理摘要：none 不提供，auto 自动，concise 简洁，detailed 详细。仅对支持此参数的模型生效；不是完整的内部思考过程。

model_verbosity.name: 回答详细程度
model_verbosity.description: 控制支持此参数的模型的回答篇幅：low 简短，medium 适中，high 详细。可能影响输出 token 数量，不改变推理强度。

web_search.name: 网页搜索方式
web_search.description: 控制网页搜索：disabled 禁用，cached 使用缓存结果，live 实时检索。实际可用选项以当前 Codex 版本和注册表范围为准。

model_context_window.name: 模型上下文窗口
model_context_window.description: 以 token 为单位声明模型的上下文容量，供 Codex 管理上下文使用；填写此值不会增加模型实际支持的容量。留空继承 Codex 配置。

model_auto_compact_token_limit.name: 自动压缩上下文阈值
model_auto_compact_token_limit.description: 上下文达到指定 token 数量时触发 Codex 自动压缩。压缩由 Codex 处理，可能产生模型 token 消耗；留空使用 Codex 的默认策略。

agents.interrupt_message.name: 记录原生中断消息
agents.interrupt_message.description: agent 回合被中断时，记录一条模型可见的消息；未配置时继承 Codex 配置，Codex 默认开启。

features.memories.name: 原生记忆功能
features.memories.description: 控制 Codex 的 memories 功能开关。具体行为及可用性由安装的 Codex 版本决定；插件仅传递配置，不另外调用模型生成记忆。

features.apps.name: 原生应用连接功能
features.apps.description: 控制 Codex 的 apps 功能开关。具体行为、可用连接及权限由 Codex 管理；插件仅传递配置。

features.browser_use.name: 原生浏览器操作功能
features.browser_use.description: 控制 Codex 的 browser_use 功能开关。实际支持情况及浏览器操作权限由安装的 Codex 版本决定；插件仅传递配置。

features.computer_use.name: 原生计算机操作功能
features.computer_use.description: 控制 Codex 的 computer_use 功能开关。实际支持情况及计算机操作权限由安装的 Codex 版本决定；插件仅传递配置。

analytics.enabled.name: OpenAI 使用情况分析
analytics.enabled.description: 设为 false 可关闭向 OpenAI 发送使用情况分析。不会关闭用户自行配置的 OTLP 指标导出；如需关闭后者，应另行配置 otel.metrics_exporter。

check_for_update_on_startup.name: 启动时检查更新
check_for_update_on_startup.description: 控制 Codex 启动时是否检查并提示更新，Codex 默认开启。若更新由组织统一管理，可关闭检查。

log_dir.name: Codex 日志目录
log_dir.description: 指定 Codex 日志目录。显式设置还会将 SQLite 日志写入此目录并启用终端文本日志；留空时文本日志使用 $CODEX_HOME/log，SQLite 日志使用 sqlite_home。已有数据库不会自动迁移；受管理的 sqlite_home 要求优先。

sqlite_home.name: Codex 状态数据库目录
sqlite_home.description: 指定 Codex SQLite 状态数据库的存放目录。未设置时，优先使用 CODEX_SQLITE_HOME 环境变量，否则使用 CODEX_HOME。与插件的项目运行记录目录相互独立。

model.name: 运行模型
model.description: 指定 Codex 使用的模型标识。插件通过默认模型或单次任务参数管理此值，不开放通用配置覆盖；可选模型以当前目录为准。

model_reasoning_effort.name: 模型推理强度
model_reasoning_effort.description: 指定模型使用的推理强度，必须是当前模型支持的档位。插件通过默认推理强度或单次任务参数管理；更高强度可能消耗更多模型 token。

service_tier.name: 服务档位
service_tier.description: 指定 Codex 请求的服务档位，例如 priority 或 flex。插件通过服务档位设置映射传递；实际可用性、用量与计费以 Codex 为准。

sandbox_mode.name: 沙箱模式
sandbox_mode.description: 控制运行权限：read-only 只读，workspace-write 允许写入工作区，danger-full-access 完整访问。由插件的沙箱设置管理，不开放通用配置覆盖。

sandbox_workspace_write.name: 工作区写入沙箱配置
sandbox_workspace_write.description: workspace-write 模式的沙箱配置对象，包括额外可写目录、网络访问和临时目录处理规则。插件通过专用权限逻辑管理，不开放整个对象的通用覆盖。

sandbox_workspace_write.network_access.name: 沙箱内网络
sandbox_workspace_write.network_access.description: 控制 workspace-write 沙箱能否访问网络。true 允许，false 禁止；其他沙箱模式遵循各自权限。由插件的沙箱内网络开关管理。

approval_policy.name: 命令审批策略
approval_policy.description: 控制 Codex 何时请求命令审批：never 不请求，on-request 由模型按需请求。由插件的审批设置管理；当前插件不提供已弃用的 untrusted 和 on-failure 选项。

model_reasoning_summary.name: model_reasoning_summary
model_reasoning_summary.description: A summary of the reasoning performed by the model. This can be useful for debugging and understanding the model's reasoning process. See https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#reasoning-summaries

model_verbosity.name: model_verbosity
model_verbosity.description: Optional verbosity control for GPT-5 models (Responses API `text.verbosity`).

web_search.name: web_search
web_search.description: Controls the web search tool mode: disabled, cached, indexed, or live.

model_context_window.name: model_context_window
model_context_window.description: Size of the context window for the model, in tokens.

model_auto_compact_token_limit.name: model_auto_compact_token_limit
model_auto_compact_token_limit.description: Token usage threshold triggering auto-compaction of conversation history.

agents.interrupt_message.name: Record native interruption messages
agents.interrupt_message.description: Record a model-visible message when an agent turn is interrupted. Unset inherits Codex configuration; the Codex default is true.

features.memories.name: features.memories
features.memories.description: Controls the native memories feature flag. Behavior and availability depend on the installed Codex version.

features.apps.name: features.apps
features.apps.description: Controls the native apps feature flag. Behavior and availability depend on the installed Codex version.

features.browser_use.name: features.browser_use
features.browser_use.description: Controls the native browser_use feature flag. Behavior and availability depend on the installed Codex version.

features.computer_use.name: features.computer_use
features.computer_use.description: Controls the native computer_use feature flag. Behavior and availability depend on the installed Codex version.

analytics.enabled.name: analytics.enabled
analytics.enabled.description: When `false`, disables OpenAI analytics across Codex product surfaces in this profile. Custom OTLP metrics exporters remain enabled; set `otel.metrics_exporter = "none"` to disable them.

check_for_update_on_startup.name: check_for_update_on_startup
check_for_update_on_startup.description: When `true`, checks for Codex updates on startup and surfaces update prompts. Set to `false` only if your Codex updates are centrally managed. Defaults to `true`.

log_dir.name: log_dir
log_dir.description: Directory for log files. Setting this value explicitly also routes the SQLite logs database here and enables the TUI text log in this directory. When unset, log files use `$CODEX_HOME/log` and SQLite logs use `sqlite_home`. Existing SQLite logs in `sqlite_home` are not migrated automatically. A managed `sqlite_home` requirement keeps SQLite logs in that required directory.

sqlite_home.name: sqlite_home
sqlite_home.description: Directory where Codex stores the SQLite state DB. Defaults to `$CODEX_SQLITE_HOME` when set. Otherwise uses `$CODEX_HOME`.

model_reasoning_effort.name: model_reasoning_effort
model_reasoning_effort.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

schema.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

service_tier.name: service_tier
service_tier.description: Optional explicit service tier request id for new turns (for example `default`, `priority`, or `flex`; legacy `fast` also works).

schema.description: Optional explicit service tier request id for new turns (for example `default`, `priority`, or `flex`; legacy `fast` also works).

sandbox_workspace_write.name: sandbox_workspace_write
sandbox_workspace_write.description: Sandbox configuration to apply if `sandbox` is `WorkspaceWrite`.

items.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

schema.description: Sandbox configuration to apply if `sandbox` is `WorkspaceWrite`.

sandbox_workspace_write.network_access.name: sandbox_workspace_write.network_access
sandbox_workspace_write.network_access.description: Whether the workspace-write sandbox permits network access. Other sandbox modes keep their own permission semantics.

approval_policy.name: approval_policy
approval_policy.description: Default approval policy for executing commands.
